h: Edo refinery reportedly exceeds full production capacity, with diesel supply at 620,000 litres a day
p: The Edo refinery is said to be producing above its stated capacity, with daily diesel supply reportedly reaching 620,000 litres, as marketers adjust prices after Dangote halted diesel gantry sales.
more: The development comes as fuel marketers release new diesel prices.
Analysts will watch whether pump prices ease.
